blurb: Guests can rent Sea Doo GTI jet skis or Bennington pontoons to explore Long Lake. Jet skis accommodate up to 2 riders with a max capacity of 450 pounds and come with life jackets and a full tank of gas. Pontoons are from 2021-2023 models with 60 or 90 horsepower motors, also with full gas tanks and necessary equipment included.
